name: ai-workspace
description: Tool to help generate AI/LLM prompts and instructions to make any repo AI-native ready.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run bundle && npm run bundle:e2e && node releases/ai-workspace-e2e-tester.js fixtures
scripts.test:e2e:dev: npm run bundle && ts-node --project e2e/tsconfig.json e2e/run.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.bundle: npm run build && ncc build dist/cli/index.js -o releases -m && cp releases/index.js releases/ai-workspace.js
